title: Dream of Sadat's assassination as it happened

tellings.quote: specific in my case cuz my first dream, which I chronicle in the book, was Sadat's assassination September 6, 1981, where I was in I was there.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says that while he was at Fort Bliss, Texas, in 1981, he dreamed of the assassination of the Egyptian president Anwar Sadat in Cairo at the moment it happened, and felt he was actually there. He says it was his first such dream, which he gives as September 6, 1981, and that he writes about it in his book A State of Mind: Faith in the CIA. He tells it as one reason he calls himself a kind of time traveler, someone who can see events from afar.
